name: Line property index enum
signature_or_shape: Bus1, Bus2, LineCode, Length, Phases, R1, X1, R0, X0, C1, C0, RMatrix, XMatrix, CMatrix, Switch, Rg, Xg, rho, Geometry, Units, Spacing, Wires, EarthModel, CNCables, TSCables, B1, B0, Seasons, Ratings, LineType
returns_or_effects: Defines the engine property rows for Line. CNCables and TSCables are redundant aliases of Wires.
notes: The AltDSS-Python wrapper exposes 35 of these rows as keywords; Wires is mirrored as the Python property Conductors and CNCables/TSCables are not exposed.

name: LineCode property index enum
signature_or_shape: NPhases, R1, X1, R0, X0, C1, C0, Units, RMatrix, XMatrix, CMatrix, BaseFreq, NormAmps, EmergAmps, FaultRate, PctPerm, Repair, Kron, Rg, Xg, rho, Neutral, B1, B0, Seasons, Ratings, LineType

name: Line specification sets
signature_or_shape: LineCode+Length; LineGeometry+Length; Spacing+Wires+Length; R1+X1+R0+X0+C1+C0; R1+X1+R0+X0+B1+B0; RMatrix+XMatrix+CMatrix
returns_or_effects: Complete impedance input combinations recognized by the engine. They are not the minimum properties a text command or Python constructor accepts.
errors_or_edge_cases: A commented-out spacing+wires+cncables+tscables+length set exists in the source but is not active.
notes: Mirrored in the Line/LineCode property catalog under property_requirements.conditional.

signature_or_shape: R1+X1+R0+X0+C1+C0; R1+X1+R0+X0+B1+B0; RMatrix+XMatrix+CMatrix

source.section_or_record: GetCSeqScale, L253-L259; wired to C1/C0 at L474-L475

name: C1 and C0 scaling
signature_or_shape: Getter: FUnitsConvert * 1.0e-9; setter: 1.0e-9
returns_or_effects: The constructor stores capacitance in farads (C1 := 3.4e-9, C0 := 1.6e-9); the public property reports nanofarads per unit length.

tested.environment: Windows 11 AMD64, Python 3.14.6, altdss 0.2.4, dss-python 0.15.7, backend 0.14.5; 2026-11-21

notes: Observed readback on a new Line: C1 = 3.4, C0 = 1.6.
The EPRI Line page states the default as 3.4e-9 nF per 1000 ft, which is unit-inconsistent; use the engine scale.

name: B1 and B0 derivation
signature_or_shape: B1 and B0 share the C1/C0 storage with scale 1 / (2*pi*BaseFrequency) * 1.0e-6; flagged Redundant and Units_uS_per_length
returns_or_effects: B1/B0 are an alternate microsiemens-per-unit-length entry for C1/C0, derived at the current base frequency.
errors_or_edge_cases: Changing BaseFreq changes the reported B1/B0 for unchanged capacitance.

source.section_or_record: Switch property flag L415; setter side effects L672-L701

name: Switch setter side effects
signature_or_shape: Switch flagged Ordering_First. Setting Switch=True marks SymComponentsChanged, clears linecode/geometry/spacing specs, sets R1=X1=R0=X0=1.0, C1=1.1e-9, C0=1.0e-9, Len=0.001, and resets length units
returns_or_effects: A line marked as a switch starts with the switch impedance and length defaults regardless of prior values.
errors_or_edge_cases: The branch does not assign SymComponentsModel; sequence-model selection comes from the constructor default and the r1/x1/r0/x0/C1/C0/B1/B0 branch.

tested.environment: Windows 11 AMD64, Python 3.14.6, altdss 0.2.4, dss-python 0.15.7, backend 0.14.5; 2026-11-21

notes: Observed after Switch=True: R1=X1=R0=X0=1.0, C1=1.1, C0=1.0, Length=0.001, Units=none.

signature_or_shape: Phases=3, Nconds=3, Nterms=2, IsSwitch=False, R1=0.0580, X1=0.1206, R0=0.1784, X0=0.4047, C1=3.4e-9, C0=1.6e-9, Len=1.0, Rg=0.01805, Xg=0.155081, rho=100.0, NormAmps=400.0, EmergAmps=600.0, PctPerm=20.0, FaultRate=0.1, HrsToRepair=3.0, LengthUnits=NONE, FLineType=1 (OH)

name: BaseFreq inheritance
signature_or_shape: The constructor does not assign BaseFrequency ('set in base class'); FetchLineCode assigns BaseFrequency := LineCodeObj.BaseFrequency
returns_or_effects: A Line uses the circuit or line-code base frequency rather than a fixed constructor value.

tested.environment: Windows 11 AMD64, Python 3.14.6, altdss 0.2.4, dss-python 0.15.7, backend 0.14.5; 2026-11-21

notes: Observed BaseFreq = 60.0 for a new Line in a 60 Hz circuit.

name: Bus1 and Bus2 required flags
signature_or_shape: Both are TPropertyType.BusProperty with TPropertyFlag.Required
returns_or_effects: A Line model needs both terminal buses to be complete.
notes: AltDSS-Python new() requires only the name positionally; the required flag governs model completeness.

name: Phases change reallocates conductors
signature_or_shape: When phases changes and no geometry is set under the sequence model, NConds := FNphases and the element data is recalculated
returns_or_effects: A Line has the same number of conductors per terminal as phases when geometry is not used.
errors_or_edge_cases: If a geometry is in use, the change is rejected with message 18101 and the previous phase count is restored.

name: Setting R1/X1/R0/X0/C1/C0/B1/B0 selects the sequence model
signature_or_shape: KillLineCodeSpecified, KillGeometrySpecified, KillSpacingSpecified, ResetLengthUnits, SymComponentsChanged := TRUE, SymComponentsModel := TRUE
returns_or_effects: Any sequence parameter replaces prior line code, geometry, and spacing specifications.
notes: This is the branch that sets SymComponentsModel := TRUE; the Switch branch does not.

name: Setting RMatrix/XMatrix/CMatrix selects the matrix model
signature_or_shape: KillLineCodeSpecified, SymComponentsModel := FALSE, clears sequence tracking for R/X/C/B, ResetLengthUnits, KillGeometrySpecified, KillSpacingSpecified
returns_or_effects: Matrix values replace sequence and line-code definitions.

name: Length and Units defaults
signature_or_shape: Len := 1.0 (commented '1 kFt'); LengthUnits := UNITS_NONE; UserLengthUnits := UNITS_NONE; FUnitsConvert := 1.0
returns_or_effects: Length defaults to 1 in the impedance length unit; declaring Units changes the modeled length conversion.

name: BaseFreq dynamic default
signature_or_shape: PropertyFlags[basefreq] include DynamicDefault, NonNegative, NonZero, Units_Hz; constructor assigns Basefrequency := ActiveCircuit.Fundamental
returns_or_effects: BaseFreq follows the active circuit fundamental; there is no fixed constructor constant.

signature_or_shape: RequiresCircuit := true
returns_or_effects: LineCode objects can only be created when an active circuit exists.
notes: All observed LineCode runs were inside an active circuit; the no-circuit error path was not exercised.

name: Neutral conductor and Kron reduction
signature_or_shape: FNeutralConductor := NPhases at construction and on phase change; DoKronReduction sets FNeutralConductor := 0 and reduces the matrix order by one
returns_or_effects: Neutral designates the conductor removed by Kron reduction; after reduction it reads 0 and must be reset before another reduction.
errors_or_edge_cases: Kron is ignored for symmetrical-component definitions.
